info.name: Digital Library — Integration (Gateway)
info.description:
End-to-end integration tests against the Digital Library API Gateway (http://localhost:4000 by default).

Every request goes through the gateway — NEVER hits a microservice directly — so this collection verifies the full chain: nginx-fronted client → gateway proxy → auth/user/book/borrow microservices → gRPC fan-out → MySQL.

Folders mirror the user-facing flows: Authentication → User → Book → Borrow.

Run with Newman:

    newman run digital-library.postman_collection.json -e local.postman_environment.json

Admin-only book CRUD (POST/PUT/DELETE /books) is conditional: set ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD in the environment to enable it. Without admin creds those requests are auto-skipped (not failed). The RBAC negative test — a regular user trying to POST /books and getting 403 — always runs.
